gaps.sentence: There is little ___ that the plan will be approved.
gaps.hint: pattern: little ___ that something will happen
gaps.explanation: 'Possibility that ...' is the standard pattern; 'opportunity' means a situation that lets you do something.

gaps.sentence: The wine is the perfect ___ to the meal.
gaps.explanation: 'Complement' = something that completes or goes well with; 'compliment' is praise.
'Valuable' means worth a lot of money; 'valued' means appreciated; 'invaluable' already means priceless, so it is not graded.

gaps.sentence: One of the screws on the bracket has come ___.
The sensor is extremely ___ to changes in temperature.
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to' reacts readily to something; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.hint: past participle after 'have'; the verb takes no object
gaps.explanation: 'Rise' (rise, rose, risen) takes no object: sales have risen. 'Raise' takes an object: they raised prices.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her excellent presentation.
gaps.explanation: 'Compliment somebody on something' means to praise; 'complement' means to go well with.

gaps.sentence: Studying abroad is a wonderful ___ to practise your Spanish.
gaps.hint: a situation that lets you do something; pattern: ___ to do
gaps.explanation: 'Opportunity to do something' means a chance a situation gives you; 'possibility' is not followed by 'to'.
